'''Machook''' was a figure in the legends of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who wielded a [[magic]] [[Axe/Legends|axe]] called [[Lumat (axe)|Lumat]]. According to Ewok legends, Machook was a hero who build the first [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[City/Legends|village]] and was convinced by the spirit [[Teebo (spirit)|Teebo]] not to harm the [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. Ewoks came to name their [[Gender/Legends|male]] children after the legend.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Machook|An Ewok]] present at [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] was named for the legend.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|packtype=''Star Wars'' Comic Pack|pack=Machook, Keoulkeech & Kettch (Marvel's ''Star Wars'' #94)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCcomicpacksWM093.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Machook was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
